images.name: 높게 갈라진 왕관 월뿔
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Input image 1 role=design reference: A04 branching moon-horn bow. Input image 2 role=design reference: V01 sweeping moon-horn bow. Use their noble sapphire-blue/cobalt glow, delicate pale-gold trim and graceful asymmetry, but redesign ONE bow so HORN SCULPTURE is the unmistakable main theme. Do not reproduce the reference pictures side by side. Exactly ONE newly designed BOW total, one coherent pair of limbs, one clear wrapped handgrip, one continuous connected taut string. Portrait 1024x1536, one near-front three-quarter product view on uniform midnight-navy background. Zoom out enough that ALL horn tips and both limb tips have at least 7% clean margin around the weapon; no cropped points, no tip touching an image border. IMPORTANT MATERIAL AND SHAPE: gracefully branching, elongated, sharp, organically TWISTED ANTLER HORNS made of luminous translucent sapphire crystal, rich cobalt cores and moonlit glass surfaces. The horns have rounded or softly ridged THREE-DIMENSIONAL cross sections and taper to needle-fine points, not broad flat sword blades, plates, crescent panels or steel fins. Let irregular antler branches visibly grow from and curve around a continuous blue-crystal bow spine. Delicate thin gold seams only, tasteful sparse star engraving. Moon symbol is secondary: one small brilliant BLUE crescent gem or a clear CRESCENT-SHAPED EMPTY SPACE between curving horns. DO NOT stack multiple large filled crescent-moon pieces. Strong upper/lower and lateral structural asymmetry, elegant sweeping branches, open breathing space, spectacular refined royal craftsmanship. Must remain an identifiable functional BOW with usable grip, attached tips and string path kept open, not a staff or antler ornament. No animal head, skull, people, hands, arrows, swords, second weapon, multi-view sheet, inset, collage, words, labels, captions or watermark. H01. Build a very tall upper antler crown: THREE unequal long slender sapphire horn branches rise from the upper shoulder, one near-vertical, one curving high and far LEFT, and a shorter third returning inward, with distinct irregular heights and twists. The principal upper limb continues to the string attachment tip; the branches do not carry extra strings. The grip sits visibly below midpoint. The lower limb is much shorter and slimmer, one simple inward hook with only a tiny horn spur. A small luminous blue crescent gem rests where the antlers fork, above the grip. Strong upward-reaching crown silhouette, no broad flat lunar slabs.

visual_qa.note: 위로 높게 갈라진 세 개의 불균등한 뿔과 짧고 가벼운 하단. 열린 공간에 작은 발광 초승달 하나. 전체 활과 끝이 보이며 상단 여백은 요청한 7%보다 좁다.
visual_qa.material_note: 청색 투명 결정과 가는 금색 지지선. 일부 뿔 표면은 둥근 뿔보다 면이 잡힌 결정형으로 표현됐다.
